_about: The Puritan classics the Press sets as publish-ready books. 'Best-selling' was read from the publishers' own lists, not from Amazon (Amazon's pages refuse automated reads, and per-edition sales ranks there were scattered: one search showed Owen's Mortification at #27,054 in Books, a modern-English Rare Jewel at #38,497, the Banner Precious Remedies at #624,159). Tier 1 is Banner of Truth's Puritan Classics box set (15 titles: Banner's own best-of the Puritan Paperbacks, the best-selling Puritan series); tier 2 the rest of the 62 Puritan Paperbacks; tier 3 Reformation Heritage Books' Puritan Treasures for Today (22 titles). Lists read 2026-10-03 from banneroftruth.org/us/store/series/puritan-paperbacks/ and heritagebooks.org. RULE: the modern edition is only the pointer. Every book is set from its original public-domain edition; a modern publisher's abridgement, updated wording, selection, introduction or notes is never copied.
